notes: u32 generator state: seed * 3877 + 29573 stays below 2^30, so plain * and + never overflow.
Both cumulative tables are summed in f64 at compile time (comptime); pick is a linear scan over them.
Each line is filled into a [61]u8 array and written into a 64 KiB std.Io.Writer over stdout; ALU lines are sliced from alu ++ alu[0..60], concatenated at compile time.
zig build-exe -O ReleaseFast -fstrip -mcpu baseline: no libc, a static binary on a scratch image; baseline x86-64 like the other compiled languages (Zig otherwise targets the build host's CPU).
